name: Κατσούνι
round1Evidence: Disambiguated to Psara (pin at the settlement's east side; Rhodes/Anafi namesakes excluded). Psara-specific pages (WonderGreece Psara Katsouni, greecevacationsearch Psara entry) describe it as the island's most popular sandy beach with sunbeds, WC and parking, hosting summer beach-volley tournaments. No beach bar confirmed.

name: Αμμουδέλι
round1Evidence: Lesvos beach guide: the small sandy beach 300m from Plomari square is organized with umbrellas and sun loungers and quite popular.

name: Φαρά
round1Evidence: Wikipedia (Blue Flag 2025): in summer a canteen operates at Fara offering free loungers and shade under mastic trees.

name: Χαλατσές
round1Evidence: Official bathing water profile: not formally organized but has showers, changing rooms, umbrellas and loungers plus a refreshment stand on the beach.

name: Μπάλος
round1Evidence: Balos in Ormos Koumeikon, SW Samos (pin matches; Crete namesake excluded). The official Greek bathing-water profile for this exact beach (GRBW149264276) states a section is organized with umbrellas, loungers, changing rooms and bins; samosin.gr's older 'not organized, tavernas on the road' conflicts but the official beach-specific profile is more authoritative. Tavernas are roadside, no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Μύλων
round1Evidence: Myloi beach is organized with bather facilities — umbrellas, showers, changing rooms, bins; seafront tavernas and cafes in the village.

name: Ζαρίτσι
round1Evidence: Zaritsi (Tyros) is partially organized with beach bars for coffee/drinks and tavernas; the organized Zaritsi Camping operates beside it.

name: Παραλία Βερβένων
round1Evidence: Kato Vervena / Paliochano beach: a canteen mid-beach offers plenty of loungers and umbrellas, with ample free space for own equipment.

name: Πούλιθρα
round1Evidence: Poulithra's pebble beach is partly organized — sunbeds available on a section of the beach, with tavernas along the shore.

name: Σιδερώνα
round1Evidence: Siderona near Korfos, Korinthia (pin matches). Beach-specific Greek sources: 'ανοργάνωτη, ωστόσο υπάρχει ένα ταβερνάκι ακριβώς δίπλα' whose fish taverna 'απλώνει μερικές ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω στην ακροθαλασσιά' — the taverna puts a few umbrellas and sunbeds on the shore. Sunbeds genuinely present (taverna-run, limited); no beach bar.

name: Αγία Βαρβάρα
round1Evidence: Skoutari/Agia Varvara beach (Lakonia): 'Σε κάποια σημεία θα βρείτε ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, ενώ στην περιοχή λειτουργούν εστιατόρια και ταβέρνες' — partial sunbed coverage.

name: Παραλία Κότρωνα
round1Evidence: Kotronas is called 'one of the most well-known and organized beaches in Laconian Mani': 'There are some sun loungers and showers, and there are shops for food and coffee around the area.'

name: Πεταλίδι
round1Evidence: 'Petalidi is an organized beach with crystal-clear waters and all facilities near the village' with a promenade of tavernas and cafes; sunbeds not explicitly itemized (beach also has a Seatrac and accessibility infrastructure per our data).

name: Καμπί
round1Evidence: Kea's Kambi is described as organized mainly on its right side with umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and cabins from a beach bar, plus a taverna on the road above.

name: Παραλία Κολώνα
round1Evidence: Kythnos Kolona unambiguous (isthmus to Agios Loukas islet). Recent specific reports: one section rents umbrellas/sunbeds at €30 for 2 front-row / €20 back row, plus a taverna above the beach and a café-snack beach bar. Older guides still say 'not organized, bring equipment' — the priced, operator-specific recent account wins per recency/specificity; main sandy isthmus remains free.

name: Απόλλωνας
round1Evidence: Village beach of Apollonas described as organized with umbrellas and loungers, surrounded by tavernas and cafes.

name: Μουτσούνα
round1Evidence: The Moutsouna bay hosts two beaches, one of which is described as fully organized with sunbeds, umbrellas, lifeguard, changing rooms and showers.
